extracted.intended_audience: general readers, researchers, journalists and stakeholders interested in Olympic governance
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts the duties, membership rules and the missions/responsibilities of the International Olympic Committee's Executive Board and its commissions as described on the page. Useful for understanding IOC governance, responsibilities and commission mandates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive Board composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Its members include the President, four Vice Presidents, and ten other members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Founded in 1921, the executive board manages the affairs of the IOC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Member election and term rules
rubrics_metrics.description: All members are elected, by secret ballot, by a majority of votes cast, for a four-year term.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting convening rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Meetings can only be conducted if convened by the president or at the request of the majority of its members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assume general overall responsibility for the administration of the IOC
rubrics_metrics.description: Assume the general overall responsibility for the administration of the IOC;

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor observance of the Olympic Charter
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitor the observance of the Olympic Charter;

rubrics_metrics.name: Approve internal organisation and regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: Approve the IOC's internal organisation, its organisation chart and all internal regulations relating to its organisation;

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage finances and prepare annual report
rubrics_metrics.description: Manage the IOC's finances and prepares an annual report;

rubrics_metrics.name: Report proposed changes to Session
rubrics_metrics.description: Present a report to the Session on any proposed change of the Olympic Charter, one of its Rules or bye-laws;

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommend persons for election to the IOC
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit, on proposal of the Nomination Commission, to the IOC Session the names of the persons whom it recommends for election to the IOC;

rubrics_metrics.name: Conduct candidature acceptance and selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct the procedure for acceptance and selection of candidatures for the organisation of the Olympic Games;

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish agenda for IOC Sessions
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish the agenda for the IOC Sessions;

rubrics_metrics.name: Appoint the Director General
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon proposal from the President, it appoints the Director General;

rubrics_metrics.name: Enact regulations to implement Olympic Charter and organise Games
rubrics_metrics.description: Enact, in the form it deems most appropriate, (codes, rulings, norms, guidelines, guides, instructions) all regulations necessary to ensure the proper implementation of the Olympic Charter and the organisation of the Olympic Games;

rubrics_metrics.name: Organise periodic meetings with IFs and NOCs
rubrics_metrics.description: Organise periodic meetings with the IFs and with the NOCs at least once every two years;

rubrics_metrics.name: Create and allocate IOC honorary distinctions
rubrics_metrics.description: Create and allocate IOC honorary distinctions;

rubrics_metrics.name: Perform other duties assigned by the Session
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform all other duties assigned to it by the Session.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commissions general governance rules
rubrics_metrics.description: These commissions have individual missions in the Olympic Movement. They may be created by the president, the IOC executive board, or the Olympic Charter. The president is an ex officio member of all commissions, designates its members and determines their dissolution once they have fulfilled their mandates. No commission can hold a meeting without permission of the president unless otherwise noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Athletes' Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Represent athletes within the Olympic Movement, support them so they can succeed in their sporting and non-sporting careers, and empower the network of athlete representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Athletes' Entourage Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Improve the quality and the level of services to athletes by engaging with and uniting the stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Audit Committee mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Assist the Director General's Office in fulfilling its responsibilities in terms of risk management, financial reporting, compliance, control and governance.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Esports Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise the IOC's Esports and oversee the planning and organisation of upcoming Olympic Esports Games.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Future Host Commission For The Olympic Winter Games mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore, create and oversee interest in future Olympic Winter Games and Winter Youth Olympic Games.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Future Host Summer Commission For The Games Of The Olympiad mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore, create and oversee interest in future Games of the Olympiad and Summer Youth Olympic Games.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Coordination Commission (Brisbane 2032) mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise the planning and organisation of the Games of the XXXV Olympiad Brisbane 2032.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Coordination Commission (French Alps 2030) mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise the planning and organisation of the XXVI Olympic Winter Games French Alps 2030.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Coordination Commission (Los Angeles 2028) mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise the planning and organisation of the Games of the XXXIV Olympiad Los Angeles 2028.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Coordination Commission (Dakar 2026 YOG) mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise the planning and organisation of the 4th Youth Olympic Games Dakar 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Culture and Olympic Heritage Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise all the activities of the Olympic Movement that are related to culture in the broadest sense of the term - art, history, focus on values, academic research and patrimonial collections – with a view to promoting the Olympic ideals as widely as possible, especially among young people all over the world.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Digital and Technology Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise all matters relating to marketing and digital programs

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Ethics Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Safeguard the ethical principles of the Olympic Movement, keep the Code of Ethics updated, examines situations involving possible breaches of the ethical principles and, if necessary, proposes sanctions.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Finance Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide advice and recommendations relating to the IOC's financial management in order to safeguard continuity and strengthen the transparency and good governance of the IOC and the Olympic Movement.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Members Election Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose and implement a new targeted recruitment process of IOC Members as per recommendation 38 of Olympic Agenda 2020

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Legal Affairs Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise the legal affairs of the IOC. This includes providing legal opinions, consider defence actions and study the legal nature of issues that may affect the interests of the IOC.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Television And Marketing Services Board Of Directors mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise all Olympic Television and Marketing operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Medical and Scientific Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a guiding reference for all other sports organisations on matters relating to the protection of the health of athletes.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Olympic Channel Board Of Directors mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain year-round interest in the Olympic movement, carrying documentaries and other programming chronicling the Olympic Games, as well as coverage of events in Olympic sport outside of the Games.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Olympic Education Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise the promotion of Olympic values-based education and provides strategic direction on IOC programmes and activities related to the education of youth through sport.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Olympic Programme Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Analyse Summer, Winter and Youth Olympic Games programmes and form proposals for consideration by the IOC Executive Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Olympic Solidarity Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide assistance to all the National Olympic Committees (NOCs) for athlete development programmes, in particular those with the greatest needs of it.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Olympism 365 Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Strengthen the role of sport and Olympism in society as important enablers of the UN Sustainable Development Goals, 365 days a year.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Commission for Public Affairs and Social Development Through Sport mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Protect and promote the autonomy and neutrality of sport. It also advises on the role of sport and Olympism in society, as a contributor to the UN Sustainable Development Goals, and as a contributor to peace. It recommends approaches to position the IOC as a thought-leader and policy-influencer on the international stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Technology And Technical Innovation Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure that the IOC has the appropriate strategies relating to the secure and sustainable use of technology in support of the IOC's daily operations, the delivery of the Olympic Games and of the Youth Olympic Games.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Sustainability and Legacy Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise sustainability and legacy matters and make informed, balanced decisions that maximise positive impacts, minimise negative impacts and foster positive change and legacies in the social, economic and environmental spheres.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gender Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Supervise the implementation of the gender equality and inclusion strategy to enable them to make informed and balanced decisions to advance gender equality in sport on and off the field of play across the three spheres of responsibility of the IOC.

rubrics_metrics.name: IOC Revenues And Commercial Partnerships Commission mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Give guidance, perspective and ideas in the area of Olympic marketing and commercial partnerships which will assist the IOC to continue to generate, enable and grow long-term, sustainable revenue streams for the Olympic Movement.
